source: Specification v0.9 Turn structure, actions, planning and serialization; approved design sections3,5,9
scope: Stage3 orders and resolver, not combat/spell effects

checks.requirement: Editable drafts, revision/control validation and unordered defaults
testNames: revises and clears drafts atomically and defaults unordered units to Total Defence
rejects foreign control, excessive movement, disconnected paths and late Dash without mutation
enforces ordinary/Double Action, Subdued and Total Defence whole-turn budgets
halves positive Slowed movement, preserves zero and prevents restrained movement
grants Dash movement only after its early action resolves
applies Defend for the entire chosen phase before its initiative
reserves, replaces and cancels resources without overspending or mutating the prior ledger
uses Dex, smaller Size and wizard proximity for action initiative
uses Move, larger Size and proximity for movement; Slowed then Quick come last
assigns unique random ties independently of source-array order
snapshots wizard distances at each phase beginning and retains an already-built queue
resolves whole paths in movement order and stops before a still-occupied cell
does not swap allied creatures and permits paths into space vacated by a faster creature
skips not-yet-ready and incapacitated creatures without granting default defence
skips a summon that dies after the phase queue snapshot without changing order
does not expose opponents drafts, reservations or random queue keys
restores at every atomic boundary with identical events, random state and outcome
rejects corrupted mid-resolution cursor and unsupported saved actions
loads permanent planning and mid-movement fixtures without changing their encoding
uses explicit clock deadlines, supports disabled timers and ignores lock/deadline races
auto-locks the latest draft at deadline and resets missed turns on participation
surrenders on the third consecutive miss, unbinds summons and collapses servants/illusions
produces a draw when all remaining players surrender together
